qualifier: via PI3K, RAC1 and CDK5 effectors
name: BDNF/NTF3-TRKB signaling via PI3K, RAC1 and CDK5
rationale: All members concern BDNF/NTF3 activation of NTRK2 and its PI3K/AKT, RAC1 and CDK5 outputs, unlike the TRKB FRS2/PLCG1/RAS-branch theme, the TRKA/NGF themes and the NMDAR-RAC1 synaptic plasticity theme.

qualifier: in gastrulation, axis elongation and neural plate shaping
name: Convergent extension in gastrulation and neural plate morphogenesis
rationale: Members are convergent extension tissue movements (gastrulation, axis elongation, organogenesis) and neural plate morphogenesis, distinct from neural plate patterning/specification and planar polarity protein localization themes.

name: Stress protein quality control with methylglyoxal glycation repair
rationale: Members cover protein repair, methylglyoxal handling, nitrosative/manganese stress and restraint of folding, mitochondrial targeting and chaperone-mediated autophagy; protein repair and methylglyoxal set it apart from heat-shock, refolding, aggrephagy and ROS-detoxification neighbours.

core: Great artery and outflow tract development
name: BMP signaling in great artery and pulmonary vascular development
rationale: Members combine BMP/SMAD signaling with pulmonary, coronary and pharyngeal arch artery morphogenesis, outflow tract and ductus closure, and lung/systemic arterial pressure, unlike endothelial-identity, valve and heart-tube neighbours.

name: Chromosome condensation and centromeric CENP-A nucleosome deposition
rationale: Members are mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation and CENP-A chromatin assembly at centromeres, distinct from general replication-coupled chromatin assembly and sister-chromatid cohesion/spindle themes.

name: Neuropeptide and opioid GPCR signaling in sleep-wake regulation
rationale: Members cover orexin/neuropeptide and opioid receptor signaling, dense-core vesicle release, nerve impulse modulation and sleep/wake control, whereas confusables are neuropeptide-driven social, feeding and stress behaviours.

core: Pathogen manipulation of host epithelial cells
qualifier: Listeria invasion and SARS coronavirus host targeting
name: Listeria invasion and SARS coronavirus manipulation of host cells
rationale: Members are Listeria InlA/InlB entry, bacterial attachment and actin-based motility plus SARS-CoV-1/2 targeting of host junctions, signaling and cell death, unlike RSV maturation, bacterial toxin and Mtb phagosome themes.

qualifier: steroidogenesis with thyroid, growth hormone and leptin axes
name: Steroidogenesis and thyroid, growth hormone and leptin endocrine signaling
rationale: Members span adrenal/gonadal steroid biosynthesis and its CYP defects plus thyroid hormone, growth hormone, prolactin and leptin signaling, distinguishing it from vitamin A/D/K metabolism and growth-rate neighbours.

qualifier: with lysosomal and Golgi membrane trafficking
name: Glycolipid transfer with lysosomal and Golgi membrane trafficking
rationale: Members are glycosphingolipid/ceramide-1-phosphate transport plus lysosome, Golgi membrane and lysosomal enzyme secretion modules, unlike glycosphingolipid synthesis/catabolism and phospholipid-transfer neighbours.

qualifier: IL-1 and IL-12 production and Toll/IL-1 signaling
name: Negative regulation of IL-1 and IL-12 inflammatory cytokine signaling
rationale: Members restrain IL-1alpha/beta and IL-12 production and regulate Toll and IL-1 signaling, versus neighbours centred on IL-6/TNF/IL-10 regulation, TLR2/4 suppression or inflammasome processing.

name: Sensory, social and vocal behavior with striatum-amygdala development
rationale: Members are sensory-driven, social, vocal, grooming and exploratory behaviours with striatal/amygdala development and MECP2-GABA regulation, unlike locomotor/cerebellar and MECP2 molecular-function neighbours.

name: Telomere DNA replication, recombination and topological remodeling
rationale: Members are telomere maintenance by recombination and replication, D-loop/t-circle handling, fork reversal and DNA topological change, distinct from telomere capping/protection and R-loop/crosslink repair neighbours.

qualifier: via dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma production
name: Th1 polarization via dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma production
rationale: Members promote Th1 differentiation, DC cytokine and IL-12, IFN-gamma, GM-CSF and MHC II production, whereas neighbours concern IFN-gamma receptor signaling, Treg/memory and CD8 responses.

name: RUNX3 regulation and its pro-apoptotic, cell-cycle-arrest targets
rationale: All members are RUNX3 regulation and its transcription of BIM, p14-ARF and CDKN1A, unlike TGF-beta receptor mutant, PAX3 and CDH1 transcription neighbours.

name: Bone and tooth enamel-dentin mineralization
rationale: Members regulate bone mineralization, dentinogenesis, enamel mineralization, tooth eruption and chondrocyte development, unlike phosphate/vitamin D homeostasis and odontoblast/cementum neighbours.

qualifier: platelet integrin signaling and vitamin K carboxylation
name: Platelet integrin signaling, coagulation cascade and vitamin K carboxylation
rationale: Members cover platelet activation and adhesion, coagulation factors and their defects, fibrinolysis and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation; integrin/Rap1 adhesion signaling separates it from the eicosanoid-rich near twin and the Rho, vascular smooth muscle and ECM neighbours.

qualifier: factor VIII, IX and V defects
name: Factor VIII, IX and V defects in coagulation amplification
rationale: Members are intrinsic-pathway amplification and defective F8, F9 and FV variants, whereas neighbours add initiation, fibrin formation, fibrinolysis, VWF or FXII/kallikrein components.

name: Presynaptic modulation of glutamate release and transmission
rationale: Members are presynaptic modulation and regulation of glutamate secretion and of glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission, unlike vesicle exocytosis machinery and presynaptic calcium/GPCR channel neighbours.

qualifier: cytosolic ASS1, ASL and ARG1 steps
name: Cytosolic urea cycle enzyme deficiency disorders
rationale: All three members are inherited ASS1, ASL and ARG1 deficiencies, the cytosolic urea cycle steps, unlike neighbours with OTC/ornithine transporter defects and normal urea cycle metabolism.

name: Naive B cell transcriptional and surface signatures
rationale: Members are B cell and naive B cell expression/surface modules, unlike neighbours with memory B, germinal centre, plasma cell and B cell activation content.

name: Inositol pyrophosphate and nuclear phosphoinositide metabolism
rationale: Members are cytosolic inositol pyrophosphate synthesis, diphosphoinositol and diadenosine polyphosphate hydrolysis and nuclear IP/PIP synthesis, unlike PTEN/AKT, ER-lumen IP and nucleotide interconversion neighbours.

qualifier: compartmental phosphoinositide synthesis and ER tubular network
name: Compartmental phosphoinositide synthesis and ER tubular network lipid transfer
rationale: Members cover PI/PIP/IP synthesis at ER, Golgi, endosome and plasma membranes, ER tubule shaping and fusion, intermembrane lipid transfer and Miro GTPases, unlike mitochondrial tethering, phosphatase regulation and flippase neighbours.

name: Immediate-early growth factor and inflammatory stress response
rationale: Members are growth factor-induced early genes, PI3K/AKT/mTOR and TNF/NF-kB hallmarks, p38 activation and growth arrest, unlike AP-1/UV response and TAK1-JNK kinase cascade neighbours.

qualifier: TRIF and TRAF6-TAK1 adaptor arms to inflammatory cytokines
name: Toll-like receptor TRIF and TRAF6-TAK1 signaling to inflammatory cytokines
rationale: Members are TRIF/TICAM1, IRAK2, TRAF6-TAK1 and RIP1-IKK TLR signaling, TRIF-mediated death and IL-6/IL-8/TNF induction, unlike broad NF-kB, negative cytokine regulation, inflammasome and TLR3-IRF deficiency neighbours.

name: De novo pyrimidine ribonucleotide synthesis to UTP
rationale: Members are de novo pyrimidine base and UDP/UTP synthesis, unlike pyrimidine salvage, deoxynucleotide, catabolism and purine biosynthesis neighbours.
